title: Our View | Accountability: Why You Should Vote for Gibbs
generalEvidence: Dated October 10, 2026 (byline: Signal Editorial Board): "of the two candidates vying to represent the 27th, we are confident that one of them — Jason Gibbs" (the two-candidate November 3, 2026 general contest against incumbent George Whitesides).
whyItCounts: Newspaper editorial board for the Santa Clarita Valley (independent of SCNG) that publishes 'Our View' candidate endorsements.
notes: Only 2026 general-election editorial found on the Signal Editorials index as of Oct 18, 2026; earlier 2026 editorials (May 9 AD40 Ahlers and Schiavo; May LA Mayor Pratt) were for the June 2 primary and are excluded. More endorsements may follow. Page read in Chrome (WebFetch 403).
